description: 500-row seeded CSV (evals/generators.py sales_csv seed 11); median of value for group C, status active (65 rows, 511.95).
prompt: sales.csv has 500 rows with columns id,group,status,value. Considering only rows where group is C and status is active, compute the median of value. Write just the median, with two decimals, to median.txt (compute it with a script or shell tools, not by eye) and report it.

args.command: python3 -c "import csv,statistics;v=[float(r['value']) for r in csv.DictReader(open('sales.csv')) if r['group']=='C' and r['status']=='active'];open('median.txt','w').write('%.2f\n'%statistics.median(v))" && cat median.txt

mock.final: The median value for group C, active rows is 511.95 (saved in median.txt).
